# arbor

**A lightweight framework for distributed task handoff between heterogeneous systems.**

arbor is opinionated about one thing: when a task moves from one system to another, both systems should know it happened and agree on when.

## Status

This project is actively maintained. See [CHANGELOG.md] for recent updates.

*[Note: CHANGELOG.md last modified 847 days before most recent README access. Eleven commits in the final week. None after.]*

## Why arbor

We built arbor because existing handoff protocols assumed synchronous acknowledgement. In practice, systems that need to hand off tasks are often under load, intermittent, or operating at different speeds. arbor is designed for the realistic case.

## What arbor does not do

arbor does not decide which system should receive a task. That decision is yours. arbor only ensures that if a task moves, it moves cleanly.
